description: NSDI.GOV.GE (Georgian national spatial data infrastructure geoportal) is a portal or repository of infrastructure or hazard data run by National Agency of Public Registry of Georgia. The geoportal consolidates spatial data from public bodies and private companies; search summaries list maps, orthophotos, land parcel boundaries, cultural heritage sites, roads, bridges, hospitals and educational institutions, and private companies supplying the location of their infrastructure and coverage areas. It is being made compatible with INSPIRE. Coverage: Georgia. Access is free of charge but needs registration (the metadata catalogue redirects to a login page). The licence is: not stated; not read. Caveats: the page returned only its title and the metadata catalogue (catalog.nsdi.gov.ge) redirects to a login page, so layers, formats and licence are unverified. It can support locating national infrastructure layers in Georgia. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet; the data are reached through the portal page linked here. This record was written from the primary page fetched on 2026-09-30 but its text could not be read; statements come from search result summaries; the data themselves were not downloaded.
